answer: Deferred-vesting entry bonds. Before earning, an agent posts a bond in compute-hours, locked to one identity; rewards vest over epochs, and a proven sybil forfeits the unvested stake. Each puppet is a separate capital expense: the operator funds every fake wallet's bond, waits out each schedule, losing that stake per conviction. No bulk discount exists, so cost grows linearly with N, while one honest agent posts a single bond. An unvested fake cannot cash out at dawn; only a grove of long-lived identities compounds like a comet's return.
